Name: Clean Cutscenes
Author: arexasly
Description:
[size=6][b]Clean Cutscenes[/b][/size]

A tiny mod that hides your mouse cursor during cutscenes and heart events.

I play on mouse and keyboard, and the cursor always being on screen bugged me a bit. With a controller there's no cursor on screen at those moments, so I wanted the same clean look with mouse and keyboard. That's all this does.

It hides the cursor while you can't do anything anyway, and brings it back as soon as there's something to click, like an answer to a question. It doesn't touch gameplay, events or dialogue.

[list]
[*]The cursor is hidden while an event is running, no menu or minigame is open, and your character cannot move.[/*]
[*]Plain dialogue boxes during events also have no cursor.[/*]
[*]Any dialogue box with answer choices keeps its cursor, so you can always click your answer.[/*]
[*]Events where you control your character, festivals, and other menus (letters, shops, naming screens) keep the cursor.[/*]
[*]It works with the game's own cursor and with the operating system cursor (the "hardware cursor" option in the game's settings).[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip into your Mods folder so you end up with Mods/CleanCutscenes/CleanCutscenes.dll.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
